evals.prompt: I just cloned this template for a new CLI tool. Help me set it up.
evals.expected_output: The init-project skill runs its Phase 0 scan, including the inherited-docs sweep, then asks the first interview question on its own and waits.
assertions: bash .claude/skills/init-project/scripts/check_inherited_docs.sh runs before the first question
The first reply to the user contains exactly one question
No folder or file is created in the first turn

evals.prompt: Let's start a coding session. What should I work on today?
evals.expected_output: Run in an already-initialized project. This is the /session-start workflow, not first-time setup, so the init-project skill is not used and no setup interview starts.
assertions: The init-project skill is not invoked
No setup interview question (project name, problem, stack) is asked

evals.prompt: Fresh clone of the template. Get it going. I'm building a Python CLI that renames photos by their EXIF date.
evals.expected_output: The interview asks one question at a time even though the prompt already answers some of them: no list of upcoming questions, no progress counter, and no question the prompt has already made moot.
assertions: The first question message contains exactly one question
No list or preview of later questions appears
No progress counter such as 'question 1 of 16' appears
It does not ask whether the project needs a frontend or what kind of thing it is, which the prompt already answered
